description: This file defines the DDOS class within the Opencart admin extension, handling the user interface and management functions for a DDOS fraud detection module, including listing, installing, and uninstalling the extension, as well as reporting on IP addresses involved in potential DDOS activities.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Controller class for managing DDOS fraud detection extension in Opencart admin panel, providing functions for loading the UI, saving settings, installation, uninstallation, and reporting IPs involved in DDOS activity.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the DDOS management page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, configurations, and views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration changes for the DDOS extension, checking permissions, updating settings, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the DDOS extension if the user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the DDOS extension if the user has permission.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays a paginated list of IPs involved in potential DDOS activity, including number of associated customers and links for further filtering.
